custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. AI often struggles with repeating curved text. If the text is mostly correct but has minor kerning issues, rate severity low. If characters are morphed, rate higher. Also, check if the 'slick' nature of the tires was misinterpreted by the router as a missing tread defect; it is not a defect for racing tires.
